chosen_titles.rationale: Title 36 (Public Officers and Employees) houses the Code of Ethics (Ch. 25, §§36-25-1 et seq.), which contains the lobbyist registration (§36-25-1.1), activity reports (§36-25-23), additional reports (§36-25-24), and oath (§36-25-22) provisions.

notes: Alabama's lobbying-disclosure regime is codified inside the Code of Ethics under Title 36 (single unified regime — no separate legislative-branch / executive-branch titles to add). Title 17 (Elections) is campaign-finance and out of scope; Title 29 (Legislature) covers internal procedure, not lobbyist disclosure.
